card.name: Comma after muscle rigidity in NMS
card.fires_on: Mostly the comma after "muscle rigidity" in the neuroleptic malignant syndrome (NMS) symptom list. Also fires on a few separators in numbered lists and partway through a drug name.

modes.label: NMS symptom list comma
modes.description: The comma after "hyperpyrexia, muscle rigidity" just before "altered mental status".
modes.example: Clinical manifestations of NMS are hyperpyrexia, muscle rigidity<<,>> altered mental status and evidence of autonomic

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A space after a semicolon between numbered contraindication items.
modes.example: 2. Undiagnosed abnormal vaginal bleeding;<< >>3. Use in pregnancy or in women

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: A piece inside a longer drug name such as tolvaptan.
modes.example: Patients should avoid grapefruit juice beverages while taking to<<lv>>aptan tablets
